description: Verify that DUT's ICMP Echo Reply IPv4 header carries Version=4 — the response must declare the same protocol version as the receive path
approach:
[Objective]
While the receive path validates the inbound Version, the emit path must also place the right value in outgoing packets.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: ICMP Echo Request (Version=4)

2. Observation (3 s window):
   • DUT → Tester: Echo Reply
      - IPv4 Version == 4   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Reply's IPv4 Version field equals 4.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_version — Reply emitted but Version was not 4
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit a Reply within the window

verdicts.Pass: Reply carried Version=4 — normal emit path
verdicts.Fail_version: Reply emitted with Version != 4 — emit path malformed
verdicts.Fail_timeout: DUT did not emit a Reply within the window
